app_type: Multi-page premium editorial marketing site for an international trading house (Award-level / Awwwards SOTD aesthetic)
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact creative direction strictly: warm, architectural, tactile, editorial visual identity. BANNED: generic corporate blue, SaaS cards, rounded buttons, gradients, glassmorphism, or glow effects.

Color Palette Execution: Primary BG: Warm Ivory #F3F0E8; Secondary BG: Bone #E7E1D5; Hero/Footer/Dark Chapters: Forest Black #17231D; Deep Olive #29372E; Accent/CTAs: Burnt Copper #B65A32; Terracotta #C98262 (agriculture); Sage #A9B9A5 (sourcing); Dusted Stone #B9B2A4 (minerals); Pale Sand #D8CBB5; Text: Graphite #202522; Muted Text: Olive Grey #69716A.

Typography: Headlines must be oversized (80px–160px on desktop), tight line-height, left-aligned, asymmetrical. Mix contemporary sans (Manrope or Satoshi/General Sans fallback) with restrained editorial serif (Instrument Serif or Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond for key quotes/monograms).
Buttons & Radii: 0-4px border radius only. Use text+arrow or outlined rectangular or solid Burnt Copper buttons. NO rounded pill buttons.

Navigation: Architectural layout — AITH monogram on left, About/Products/Solutions/Markets/Insights in center, Partner + Request Quote on right. Blends seamlessly into Forest Black hero, then transitions on scroll to compact floating ivory nav with blur and 1px border (#202522 opacity 10%).

Hero Section: Cinematic Forest Black (#17231D), massive cropped port/commodity imagery, headline 'FROM ASIA. TO EVERYWHERE.' with Burnt Copper accent, technical engraved annotations (coordinates 28°36'N 77°13'E, port codes, trade routes), bottom info strip (GLOBAL SOURCING | IMPORT | EXPORT | PROCUREMENT | BULK TRADING | SUPPLY CHAIN).
Key Sections Required on Home Page:
01/ WHO WE ARE: Massive editorial statement 'WE CONNECT PRODUCTS, PEOPLE AND MARKETS'.
02/ Split-screen 'TRADE IS MORE THAN MOVING PRODUCTS' with overlapping imagery and technical captions (TRADE/001, SOURCE—VERIFY—DELIVER).
03/ WHAT WE DO: 5 enormous interactive editorial rows (Global Sourcing, Import & Export, International Procurement, Bulk Trading, Supply Chain) with hover image expansion and copper line.
04/ PRODUCT DISCOVERY: On Bone (#E7E1D5) background with large search field + category selector (Healthcare, Agriculture, Minerals, Chemicals, Textiles) each with muted material color identity.
05/ Featured Agriculture Showcase: Full-bleed imagery + large text-link product list (Rice, Wheat, Pulses, Spices, Fresh Produce, Dry Fruits).

06/ GLOBAL TRADE Dark Chapter: 'ONE SOURCE. MANY MARKETS.' with refined cartographic drawing (thin ivory lines, copper trade routes, tiny labels, Asia → Middle East / Africa / Europe / North America) with interactive market hover panels.
07/ HOW TRADE MOVES: Scroll-driven continuous copper line process (01 Require → 02 Source → 03 Verify → 04 Quote → 05 Coordinate → 06 Deliver).
08/ QUALITY IS A PROCESS: Stone-toned section with vertical typography process (Supplier Verification, Product Inspection, Documentation, Certifications, Regulatory Compliance).
09/ INDUSTRIES: Horizontal scroll gallery with full-bleed photography panels.
10/ SOURCING FEATURE: Sage (#A9B9A5) background 'CAN'T FIND WHAT YOU NEED? TELL US WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR.' with BUYER → AITH → SUPPLIER typographic flow.
11/ PARTNERSHIP: 3 editorial rows (Buyers / Suppliers / Distributors).
12/ TRADE INSIGHTS: Magazine-style 3 large stories.
13/ RESOURCE CENTER: Document rows with thin dividers (PDF/DOWNLOAD).

14/ REQUEST A QUOTE: Full-screen Forest Black 'HAVE A REQUIREMENT? LET'S SOURCE IT.' multi-step trade request form (6 steps: What do you need / How much / Where / When / Your company / Contact details with progress indicator 01/06 and underlined editorial inputs).
15/ FINAL CTA: 'FROM ASIA. TO THE WORLD. LET'S TRADE.'
16/ FOOTER: Minimalist with huge stacked 'ASIAN INTERNATIONAL TRADE HOUSE' typography.
Multi-page Routing: Build dedicated page views for Home, Products, Markets, Insights, and Request Quote with React Router or tabbed state fallback.
Testing Attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, search fields) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-request-quote-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent dropdowns or unstyled dialogs.
Do NOT add rounded SaaS cards or pill buttons.
Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast on all Ivory (#F3F0E8) and Forest Black (#17231D) text backgrounds.
Add data-testid to every clickable element and form input.
Use framer-motion for line drawing, clip-path reveals, and page transition effects.
